cues: The two language marks are awarded for vocabulary, so learn it in groups.
A small rise: it edged up.
A big rise: it rose, climbed, surged, doubled.
A big fall: it fell, declined, slumped, plunged.
No change: it remained steady, levelled off, plateaued.
And the turning points: it peaked at, bottomed out at, recovered.
text: The two language marks are awarded for vocabulary, so learn it in groups. A small rise: it edged up. A big rise: it rose, climbed, surged, doubled. A big fall: it fell, declined, slumped, plunged. No change: it remained steady, levelled off, plateaued. Up and down: it fluctuated. And the turning points: it peaked at, bottomed out at, recovered.
